money_rules: ₹1,00,00,000 on the first session of the window, split equally between the sleeves.

Each trade = whole NIFTY futures lots at the 2-hour close of the Nifty 50 index: lots = sleeve cash ÷ (price × lot size), lot size from the NSE F&O bhavcopy of the entry day. No leverage: the full value of the position is covered by cash.
Cost 0.035% of the position on every trade. Gains and losses stay in the sleeve, so it compounds.
A BUY rule and a SELL rule can share one sleeve: a buy is only open above EMA 105 and a sell only below, so they never overlap.
Every session is valued at its last 2-hour close; a trade still open is valued at the latest close.
After-tax profit assumes F&O income taxed at 30% + 4% cess (31.2%).
limits: Most money / best sets were chosen after seeing the same data they are scored on. The honest tests are the fairer guide.
One NIFTY lot is worth ₹15-19 lakh, so ₹1 crore funds at most 5-6 sleeves without leverage; smaller sleeves skip trades.
Fills at the index's 2-hour close. Real futures trade at a premium to the index and orders slip; idle cash earns nothing here.
Index candles from Yahoo Finance, checked against the NSE bhavcopies (see the audit).
Paper research. Not SEBI-registered advice. No orders are placed by this website.

audit.name: Nifty 50 · EMA 105 · 2-hour · two-year bhavcopy audit
audit.rule: EMA 105 only on 2-hour Nifty 50 closes: close above = BUY, close below = SELL, held until the opposite close
limits: NSE bhavcopies are end-of-day files: they give one open, high, low and close per day, not 2-hour candles. The 2-hour candles come from Yahoo Finance hourly data and are checked against NSE day by day.
The official-close version replaces only each day's last 2-hour close; the three earlier closes of the day stay Yahoo's.
Index points, not futures fills. Rupees = net points x the NIFTY lot size in the F&O bhavcopy on the entry day.
Jev labels each trade on its own from the prices given; the code's count is exact arithmetic and is the reference.
Paper research. Not SEBI-registered advice. No orders are placed by this website.
